t: 查尔斯一世成为了英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰的国王并宣称拥有法国国王头衔.
te: Charles I becomes King of England, Scotland and Ireland as well as claiming the title King of France.
dz: 查尔斯一世成为了英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰的国王并宣称拥有法国国王头衔.
de: Charles I becomes King of England, Scotland and Ireland as well as claiming the title King of France.

t: 一支由52艘船组成的西班牙和葡萄牙联合舰队在荷兰-葡萄牙战争期间开始从荷兰人手中夺回巴伊亚.
te: A combined Spanish and Portuguese fleet of 52 ships commences the recapture of Bahia from the Dutch during the Dutch–Po…
dz: 一支由52艘船组成的西班牙和葡萄牙联合舰队在荷兰-葡萄牙战争期间开始从荷兰人手中夺回巴伊亚.
de: A combined Spanish and Portuguese fleet of 52 ships commences the recapture of Bahia from the Dutch during the Dutch–Portuguese War.

t: 阿丰索·门德斯被教宗格雷戈里十五世任命为埃塞俄比亚拉丁牧首,从果阿抵达贝卢尔.
te: Afonso Mendes, appointed by Pope Gregory XV as Latin Patriarch of Ethiopia, arrives at Beilul from Goa.
dz: 阿丰索·门德斯被教宗格雷戈里十五世任命为埃塞俄比亚拉丁牧首,从果阿抵达贝卢尔.
de: Afonso Mendes, appointed by Pope Gregory XV as Latin Patriarch of Ethiopia, arrives at Beilul from Goa.

t: 詹姆斯六世和我的国葬(1566–1625)在威斯敏斯特会所举行.
te: State funeral of James VI and I (1566–1625) is held at Westminster Abbey.
dz: 詹姆斯六世和我的国葬(1566–1625)在威斯敏斯特会所举行.
de: State funeral of James VI and I (1566–1625) is held at Westminster Abbey.

t: 英格兰国王查理一世在坎特伯雷与法国和纳瓦雷的天主教公主亨丽埃塔·玛丽亚结婚.
te: King Charles I of England marries Catholic princess Henrietta Maria of France and Navarre, at Canterbury.
dz: 英格兰国王查理一世在坎特伯雷与法国和纳瓦雷的天主教公主亨丽埃塔·玛丽亚结婚.
de: King Charles I of England marries Catholic princess Henrietta Maria of France and Navarre, at Canterbury.

t: "南安普敦条约"使英格兰和荷兰共和国结盟反对西班牙.
te: The Treaty of Southampton makes an alliance between England and the Dutch Republic against Spain.
dz: "南安普敦条约"使英格兰和荷兰共和国结盟反对西班牙.
de: The Treaty of Southampton makes an alliance between England and the Dutch Republic against Spain.
